copy.headline: The energy you bring into interaction and the way you handle other people's needs are not the same thing.
copy.body: Extraversion more strongly shapes interaction frequency, expression speed, and stimulation needs; agreeableness more strongly shapes trust, negotiation, and conflict handling. Together they define your social presence.
copy.strength_sentence: Separating the two helps distinguish active connection, quiet support, direct negotiation, and careful reserve.
copy.risk_sentence: Low interaction is not the same as coldness, and high interaction is not the same as cooperation.
copy.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest in team discussion, unfamiliar social settings, and conflict; familiar one-to-one relationships may look different.
copy.action_hook: Track interaction cost and cooperation quality separately instead of collapsing them into one label.
